gen-audiowide-gf-gidole: Every curve in Audiowide keeps one constant line, like bent tubing. Gidole follows in a plain sans, its open terminals and high midline making long paragraphs feel light and easy to move through.
gen-audiowide-gf-golos-text: Audiowide is all tile-like glyphs with wide gaps between them, futuristic and a bit mechanical. Golos Text brings the approachable side, its large x-height filling each line so the pairing feels friendly beneath the tech.
gen-audiowide-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Audiowide has tall lowercase beside its capitals and no stress anywhere in its curves, which gives it a machined look. And Hedvig Letters Sans brings a similar tall small-letter stance, only softer, with a clear gap where the c ends.
gen-audiowide-gf-heebo: Hard-edged and futuristic, like bent pipe lettered in tiles. Audiowide shows off that uniform stroke; Heebo just carries the text, with tall lines and open curves.
gen-audiowide-gf-hind-guntur: Audiowide sets its glyphs like tiles with wide grout lines, and every curve keeps a single line width. Hind Guntur reads smoothly, its open curve ends and tall lowercase keeping long text steady.
gen-audiowide-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai is the approachable half here, with wide-open s curves and lowercase that fills the line. Audiowide above it adds the futuristic edge, while Hind Madurai keeps the paragraphs easy; a modest heading size lets the tiles stay crisp.
gen-audiowide-gf-hind-mysuru: Audiowide's lowercase towers over its capitals, tile-like and futuristic. Hind Mysuru reads in a plain sans, lowercase pressing toward ascender height with no calligraphic thinning, so long text moves briskly.
gen-audiowide-gf-hind-siliguri: Futuristic, with tile-like glyphs and wide gaps between them, Audiowide leads. Hind Siliguri hums along in a plain sans with constant line weight, and a gentle bump from small letters to capitals; shrink the heading and those wide gaps start to blur.
gen-audiowide-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara reads open and professional, with spacious terminal gaps and tall bowls in the e and a. And Audiowide gives it a tech-minded top line, its single stroke width echoing the body's unchanging thickness.
gen-audiowide-gf-huninn: Futuristic tiles, tall lowercase, no stroke variation: that's Audiowide. Huninn keeps its modern sans body clear, with s terminals held away from the letter; a slightly larger body size would suit its crossbars.
